name: code-editor
title: Code Editor
description: A compound code editor component built on Ace Editor with JetBrains-themed syntax highlighting, tab bar with modified indicators, and status bar.

docs.description: A compound code editor component with Ace Editor backend, JetBrains-themed syntax highlighting, multi-tab support via dynamic-tabs, and a status bar showing cursor position, encoding, and language mode.
features: Ace Editor backend with 120+ language support
Custom JetBrains theme using design tokens (--jb-* CSS variables)
Light and dark mode support via CSS variables
Tab bar with modified (dirty) state indicators
Status bar with cursor position, encoding, language mode
Compound component pattern for flexible composition
